但是，小鸡叨叨特别爱打小报告——可不是每天一次、两次的那种。

Chick Dada is not only smart and witty, but also very cute.

But Chick Dada especially loves to tattle—definitely not the kind that happens once or twice a day.

河马哥哥在抠鼻子。

Sister Heidi is always running faster than me!

Brother Hippo is picking his nose.

he's still tattling.
Sister Heidi isn't covering herself with a blanket while sleeping!

当然，小鸡叨叨并不是唯一一个爱打小报告的同学，只不过他打小报告的次数最多。
有一天，长颈鹿老师决定玩一个“小报告大比拼”的游戏。
“同学们听好了，这个游戏的规则很简单，你们分成两组，在一周之内，看哪一组小报告打得少。每打一次小报告，我会给你们组记上一分。得分最少的小组可以在星期五得到额外的休息时间。”长颈鹿老师说。
page_text_en:
Of course, little chick Dada is not the only student who loves to tattle, but he tattles the most.
One day, the giraffe teacher decided to play a game called "Tattling Competition".
"Class, listen up. The rules are simple: you'll split into two groups. Within one week, we'll see which group tattles the least. Each time you tattle, I'll give your group one point. The group with the fewest points will get extra break time on Friday," said the giraffe teacher.
summary_zh: 长颈鹿老师为了减少学生打小报告的行为，决定举办一个“小报告大比拼”游戏，规则是分组竞赛，一周内打小报告次数最少的小组可获得额外休息时间。

page_text_en:
As soon as the groups were formed, Chick Dada couldn't help but tattle.
Monkey Ada is too loud!

Flamingo Landon is standing on one leg!
His teammates were very dissatisfied with his behavior.

“小鸡叨叨，等一下，”长颈鹿老师说，“在正式开始游戏之前，我补充一条游戏规则。”

如果你的朋友生病了、受伤了，或者是遇到危险了，在这些情况下，你是可以告诉别人的。

就这样，“小报告大比拼”游戏正式开始了。
page_text_en:
"Chick Dada, wait a moment," said the giraffe teacher, "before we officially start the game, I'll add one more rule."

If your friend is sick, hurt, or in danger, in these situations, you are allowed to tell someone else.

And so, the 'Tattletale Challenge' game officially began.
summary_zh: 长颈鹿老师在开始“小报告大比拼”游戏前，补充了一条规则：只有在朋友生病、受伤或遇到危险时才可以报告。随后，小鸡叨叨挥舞着绿色旗帜，宣布游戏正式开始。

“呃……她可能会呛着。”
小鸡叨叨回答。

“好吧，”小鸡叨叨说，“我明白了。”但其实他并没有真的明白。

Giraffe teacher, beaver Ali is chewing on a pencil!

"Is she sick, hurt, or in danger?" asked Giraffe teacher.

"Well... she might choke,"
Chick Chatter replied.

"Yes, but the chance is very small."

"Okay," said Chick Chatter, "I understand." But actually, he didn't really understand.

虽然他已经尽力了，但还是不断地让他的队友们失望。一个星期快要过去了，没有小伙伴愿意跟他玩了，他感到非常孤独。
课间休息时，他独自玩耍。
午饭时，他独自吃饭。
放学之后，他仍然是独自回家。

page_text_en:
Although he had tried his best, he kept disappointing his teammates. The week was almost over, and no one wanted to play with him. He felt very lonely.
During recess, he played alone.
At lunchtime, he ate alone.
After school, he still went home alone.
No one wanted to talk to him, especially his teammates. His team was about to lose the game, and it was all his fault.
"Alright!" he said to himself,
"I'll never tattle again."
summary_zh: 小鸡叨叨因频繁打小报告导致队友疏远，感到孤独，最终决定再也不打小报告了。

如果你的朋友生病了、受伤了，或者是遇到危险了，在这些情况下，你是可以告诉别人的。

If your friend is sick, hurt, or in danger, you can tell someone else.
